name: as_glue
title: Mark a character vector as glue

origin.description: Give a character vector the glue class so it prints literally and can be added.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, a list of strings, or a value converted with as.character rules.

origin.details: The glue class prints with cat, so quotes and newlines stay visible. + calls glue on the two sides.
origin.value: A character vector of class glue.

translation.description: Wrap strings as Glue. Adding two sides concatenates them element by element.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, a list of strings, or a value converted with as.character rules.

translation.details: Glue prints each element on its own line. + concatenates the two sides with the same recycler as glue.
translation.example:
from glue import as_glue
x = as_glue(["abc", '"\\', "\n"])
print(x)
